releases.title: Compact chats and on-demand model recordings
changes: Keep user message actions below the bubble, including with older saved appearances. Tighten content padding and let longer messages use the available bubble width.
Subdue work summary headings and separators so conversations remain the focus.
Use the same contrasting theme colors for send, stop and voice controls as notification badges.
Inspect recorded model requests and responses only when you choose to view them, using a collapsible JSON viewer with paged arrays and expandable long text.

releases.title: Smoother chat loading and remembered Canvas layouts
changes: Show saved conversation text and activity together, with one control for loading earlier history.
Remember Canvas visibility, width, selected artifact/version and viewer controls separately for each chat and browser. Chats without saved preferences start with Canvas closed.
Fix worker setup when ordinary conversation configuration paths contain virtual environments or external symlinks. Qualify actual module source declarations while preserving runtime configuration.

releases.title: Cleaner conversations and smarter bundle qualification
changes: Keep message bubbles compact with actions and channel information underneath, and keep the newest user and assistant actions visible.
Hide internal observations from chat and combine adjacent work summaries while keeping detailed steps available on demand.
Turn pasted text longer than 10,000 characters into a Pasted text attachment, preserving the complete content.
Use composed bundle characteristics to distinguish partial registrations from conversation profiles during updates, regardless of file names or locations.
Reduce repeated large-chat storage writes and preserve recovery safety after interrupted saves.

releases.title: Clearer repairs, questions and update status
changes: Guide emergency reset with readable progress and a private diagnostic report, wait for macOS shutdown, and run doctor and service status before confirming readiness.
Reconnect Linux service commands to an existing user service bus and explain the setup needed when it is unavailable.
Keep committed appearance preferences when opening a new app window and during shell recovery.
Show why an update is waiting, including links to the conversations with active background work.
Include safe failure locations in component-update diagnostics and explain missing configuration or incompatible conversation profiles.
Keep pending questions in the chat reading column with a review notice, and move answered or closed questions into Chat controls.

releases.title: Emergency installation recovery
changes: Add amplifier-unified reset to reinstall a fresh app and dependencies after an interrupted update, missing packages or local installation changes.
Retire damaged runtime caches, active update pointers and interrupted-update status while preserving chats, credentials, settings, attachments and workspace files.
Keep recovery backups, restore the previous installation if repair fails, and provide a standalone recovery script when the launcher itself cannot run.

releases.title: Lighter chat loading and clearer navigation
changes: Load chat state once at startup and fetch settings history only when its page opens. Keep provider and model capabilities ready for the composer.
Share repeated navigation data, skip unchanged navigation refreshes on return, and defer hidden-tab chat rendering until the app is visible.
Highlight visible turns in the chat navigator, anchor previews beside their marks, and keep preview headings to one line.
Use immediate themed tooltips on action buttons and smart message dates after the action buttons.
Distinguish blocked work and requested decisions from errors with separate icons and attention colors.
Explain that conversation compaction can take a few minutes while updates can still be sent.

releases.title: Stable chat reading and workspace navigation
changes: Keep your reading position and draft when switching chats, show the beginning of new replies, and jump to the latest message when you choose. Browse loaded turns with previews and local bookmarks.
Browse shared provider and model catalogs without starting conversation workers. Keep reasoning controls clear while capabilities load; apply model changes when you send.
Fix workspace browsing when its chats are outside the sidebar, keeping the title, selected workspace, conversations and files in sync. Use consistent idle, active and attention icon colors.
Reuse navigation summaries when pinning chats, show only known usage amounts, and reveal message actions and dates on hover in Balanced and Focused appearances.
Show a reconnecting status during update interruptions, allow one minute for the service to return, and clear recovered connection errors.

releases.title: Smaller state saves throughout the app
changes: Save only affected chats and settings for routine commands and background updates, reducing repeated processing of unrelated conversation state.
Pin and unpin chats without loading their history or flushing unrelated work; keep pins, titles and private drafts durable across restarts.
Update question, schedule, worktree, Canvas and provider projections for their affected owners, while retaining explicit complete reconciliation for imports and recovery.

releases.title: Current AGENTS guidance and scoped dependency overrides
changes: Load optional AGENTS.md guidance from the instance settings home, the chat execution directory's .amplifier folder, and the execution directory itself. Subsequent requests observe edits and deletions without rewriting authored bundle instructions.

Apply application-selected dependency overrides explicitly to modern runtime installers instead of exporting them to the worker process. Unrelated tool subprocesses can resolve their own dependencies, while incoming caller override and constraint settings remain intact.

releases.title: Faster chat switching
changes: Show the selected chat and its loading state immediately, keeping the sidebar and conversation in sync while preserving drafts and unsaved canvas edits.
Switch between existing chats without saving or rebuilding the full conversation catalog; check saved-history freshness without copying the entire conversation.
Keep the latest selection when switching rapidly and restore the confirmed chat if navigation fails.

releases.title: Lighter conversation history refreshes
changes: Refresh and save only the chat whose work history changed, avoiding repeated processing of unrelated settings and the full chat catalog.
Keep live work details, usage totals, and restart recovery current while reducing CPU and file reads during history refreshes.

releases.title: Lighter app-state saves during active work
changes: Save changed app-state records individually, avoiding repeated writes of unrelated settings, workspaces, and session configuration during small progress updates.
Preserve atomic saves and restart recovery for conversations and private drafts; existing saved app state converts automatically on its next full save.

releases.title: Stable live work details and easier conversation continuation
changes: Expanded work lists stay visible and retain expanded steps while new work arrives. Only new or changed rows are synchronized; closed groups and large tool results remain demand-loaded.
Stopped-turn errors offer Continue conversation, which sends a fresh request using saved history while preserving your draft. Work is never replayed automatically.

releases.title: Use the selected model consistently for native compaction
changes: Apply the chat model selection to native compaction and validate the returned state against that same model, while preserving provider defaults for other sessions.
Refresh component availability after an app upgrade so a cached check cannot hide newly published runtime fixes.
Retain automatic bounded recovery for oversized saved history from 0.20.60.

notices.title: Complete the app and component update
notices.detail: This release requires the updated OpenAI provider as well as context-managed. Initial recovery of older chats may take a few minutes; saved history remains intact.
notices.action: Allow the full update sequence to complete before resuming affected chats.

releases.title: Resume oversized saved conversations
changes: Automatically recover a bounded working context when saved history exceeds the native compaction window, including after an incompatible model switch.

Preserve compatible native context, required instructions, recent complete exchanges and all original saved history. Older omitted messages remain available for lookup and are explicitly identified as outside the working context.
Save successful native compaction for reuse on subsequent turns and restarts. Native provider failures still stop clearly rather than falling back to an LLM summary.

notices.title: Update the app and included components together
notices.detail: Existing large chats recover automatically on their next message. Initial native compaction may take a few minutes; subsequent turns reuse the saved result. Recovery does not replay tools or alter original history.
notices.action: Complete the full update, then send a new message to the affected chat.

releases.title: Align installed desktop title-bar controls
changes: Center app icons and title text within the actual native title-bar strip in supported installed desktop browsers, including focused Canvas, while preserving the continuous appearance-aware background below it.
Use a distinct chat-bubble icon for Chat actions so it is not confused with the browser's native window menu. Preserve keyboard access, clickable controls and passive title dragging.
Keep the ordinary app header below native strips shorter than 32px rather than squeezing or clipping controls.

notices.title: Reload your installed desktop app after updating
notices.detail: The alignment and Chat actions icon were approved in an installed Mac Edge DTU preview. Automated checks cover simulated native geometry, all four built-in appearances in light/dark, saved custom appearance, focused Canvas and narrow-window fallbacks. Other native platforms and physical Android launch were not newly verified for this release.
notices.action: Reload the installed app to load the updated header. No reinstall or appearance reset is required. Unsupported browsers keep their ordinary title bar.

releases.title: Lighter chat history and reliable conversational steering
changes: Load work summaries first and fetch detailed steps only when expanded. Show a loading indicator while switching chats until fresh history is ready.
Use indexed JSONL reads and incremental transcript saves to reduce full-history reads and rewrites. Saved transcript and event contents are preserved.
Keep accepted steering messages in the active generation through completion boundaries, and let sends proceed while draft autosave waits. Treat ordinary pause and resume requests as conversation.
Use strict native compaction when supported, surface actionable compaction failures, and reserve LLM summaries for providers without native compaction.

notices.title: Update application and included components together
notices.detail: This release requires the updated Foundation history readers and loop-live/context-managed components. Native compaction failures now stop clearly; oversized histories without compatible compacted context can still require recovery.
notices.action: Complete the full update process and reload browser clients. Update the CLI before sharing sessions with incremental history writers.

releases.title: Integrate installed desktop window chrome
changes: Use Window Controls Overlay in supported installed desktop browsers, with a compact draggable header, native-control clearance and interactive controls excluded from dragging. Unsupported browsers keep their ordinary title bar.

Keep title-bar color aligned with appearance previews, light/dark/system changes and the committed startup appearance. Blend eligible decorative backgrounds into the solid native chrome rather than cutting them off at the header.
Allow service-worker-forwarded installed-app entry navigations without weakening cross-origin API or CSRF protections.

notices.title: Installed desktop title-bar behavior depends on the browser
notices.detail: Edge native controls still use a single solid color. The decorative join is a 96px blend in non-stacked overlay layouts; explicit custom header artwork and focused Canvas surfaces remain appearance-owned. Passive title dragging was manually confirmed on Mac Edge; the latest gradient blend and physical Android installed launch have not yet been manually verified.
notices.action: Reload your installed app after updating and check title dragging, control clicks and the appearance join. Browsers without an enabled overlay retain the ordinary title bar.

releases.title: Reduce stored execution history and startup memory
changes: Remove redundant execution details from cold storage when they can be reconstructed from native history, while preserving conversation messages, app-only records, accounting and uncertain-call recovery information.
Compact existing cold execution payloads once on startup and keep settled histories unloaded until needed.

releases.title: Steer the active run without starting another turn
changes: Send corrections and pause requests into the active run through loop-live, preserving the current turn and its usage history. Requests are considered at the next supported checkpoint.
Show whether steering is queued, applied, held, or has an unknown delivery outcome. Requests bound to a finished or replaced run are not silently replayed as new work.
Preserve attachments and quoted context when steering, and keep delivery checks from resending a request.

releases.title: Reduce overhead when conversation calls finish
changes: Reduce CPU and disk activity when model and tool calls complete, fail, or report uncertain outcomes by saving the affected conversation independently.
Keep call outcomes immediately available after restart and preserve pending application-wide changes in the same save.

releases.title: Restore conversation startup after the collaboration update
changes: Fix a conversation worker startup failure introduced in 0.20.52. Expose the application's operations package to isolated workers so ordinary checkpoints and collaboration imports succeed without exposing host dependencies.

Check the installed application's worker imports in a clean child interpreter before qualifying updates or publishing a release. Reject missing app packages and host dependency leakage with sanitized diagnostics.
Preserve saved conversations, bundle and model choices, and normal message-delivery controls. Installing this fix does not automatically retry a previously failed message.

releases.title: Coordinate independent chats in a shared workspace
changes: Let workspace chats discover and consult peers, and commission durable task chats with clear creator and request links. Task chats remain ordinary conversations with retained native history.

Approve a bounded collaboration scope once for attributed notifications, queued work and supported generation-bound steering. Preserve user stop, permissions and recipient settings; uncertain submissions are not automatically replayed.

Correlate typed replies with exact native terminal messages and admit one guarded continuation for a saved dependency. Related work shows status, artifacts and links to the original result without replacing the caller's draft.
Keep pending collaboration approvals reviewable after timeout and restart. New task chats retain the selected provider through credential references rather than copied secret values.
Include a focused coordinate-work skill and compact context for agents participating in the collaboration.

notices.title: Review collaboration scope before starting peer work
notices.detail: Chat membership alone does not authorize another chat to run. Shared folders remain cooperative rather than isolated: simultaneous file edits can still conflict, and collaboration does not grant permission to stop peers or change their settings.
notices.action: Ask a chat to consult a workspace peer or commission a task, then review the proposed scope. Use Related work to inspect pending approvals and results; use separate worktrees when edits need isolation.

releases.title: Resolve saved bundle IDs and report startup failures clearly
changes: Resolve uniquely registered bundle IDs case-insensitively when there is no exact registration or local bundle. Preserve exact aliases, paths and URLs; require an exact ID for ambiguous matches. New standalone IDs use lowercase with dashes.

Provide an explicit metadata-only repair for saved Work chat references to work, preserving transcripts, model choices and customizations without starting workers or replaying saved messages. Report busy writers and conflicting or unreadable metadata rather than silently substituting a bundle.

Retain private diagnostics for failures before worker startup and show actionable bundle-configuration guidance. Failed runtime controls settle as errors; background preparation reports unavailable instead of remaining in preparation indefinitely.

releases.title: Choose Work with Amplifier development tools by default
changes: Offer anchors, anchors-amp-dev, work and work-amp-dev by default in chat and workspace starters. Work · Amplifier development combines the Work profile with Amplifier ecosystem knowledge and tooling.
Keep chosen defaults, custom source bindings, disabled bundles and existing histories unchanged. Work remains the fallback when no default is selected.
Prepare bundle sources and dependencies on use, not eagerly during package installation. Component updates qualify the currently offered roots.

releases.title: Start workspaces with reusable setups and focused controls
changes: Choose Blank, Development or Amplifier development when creating a workspace. Duplicate built-ins into custom starters in Settings → Workspaces → Manage starters.
Offer the same registered root bundles in chat and starter controls: anchors, anchors-amp-dev and work, plus enabled standalone additions from Advanced settings.

Create workspace-container guidance and bounded root working memory without replacing existing files. Project repositories remain independent child checkouts. Amplifier development initializes local workspace Git by default, without commits or a remote; duplicate the starter to turn this off.
Keep global defaults in Settings. Manage workspace readiness, bundle overrides and external resource records in Workspace → Details, and chat-specific controls in Chat details/Chat controls.
Let provided Markdown prose wrap naturally in viewers while preserving its structural lines and user-authored text.

notices.title: Workspace and chat controls moved out of global Settings
notices.detail: Workspace readiness, resource records and workspace bundle overrides are in Workspace → Details. Chat-specific Settings destinations now link to Chat details or Chat controls. Starter changes apply only to newly created workspaces; existing files and workspaces are preserved.
notices.action: Open a workspace and choose Details for its controls. To try the new guidance and optional local Git setup, create a new workspace with the desired starter.

releases.title: Start requested updates promptly and download components together
changes: Start eligible updates immediately after a manual check, retain Install requests made during a running check, and resume staged updates as soon as blocking work finishes.
Download independent component checkouts concurrently with a bounded limit. Follow-up checks reuse recent availability results; new manual checks still refresh sources.
Include recent check timings, server update state and the browser’s displayed state in copied or saved update diagnostics, without including private paths or conversation content.

releases.title: Update configured bundles and copy useful diagnostics
changes: Prepare only bundle profiles registered in current settings. Historical registry entries no longer appear as selectable profiles or block component updates with missing-bundle errors.

Copy or save an update diagnostic report in one click, including update phases, timings, installed versions and source differences from the recorded worker installation. Reports exclude credentials, private paths and conversation content.
Preserve the existing protection for locally changed worker dependencies. Runtime repair remains an explicit maintenance action.

releases.title: Prepare shared component generations and adopt updates between work
changes: Prepare the currently offered app profiles together in one dependency installation, then check each profile in a fresh process. Historical chats and workspace combinations no longer multiply routine update preparation.

Reuse indexed source inventories and coalesced availability checks. Proven catalog-data-only changes reuse a qualified runtime; code, dependency and configuration changes still receive isolated qualification.

Share qualified component environments and exact source revisions across compatible conversation workers. Custom configurations prepare separately when first used, and conflicting requirements stop a candidate without changing the running environment.

Make compatible component updates available to new workers immediately. Active workers finish on their existing generation and adopt the update after safe retirement; active voice, queued input, approvals and uncertain operations remain protected.

Retain rollback and referenced generations, and reclaim only proven unused owned environments. Application updates still use the coordinated restart boundary. CLI caches and registries remain separate, and native history is preserved without replay.

notices.title: Use shared component generations
notices.detail: Component updates now prepare the current app offerings together. Already running conversation workers keep their loaded version until their work can safely retire.
notices.action: Let the included-components update finish once after installing this release. New work then uses the qualified generation automatically; application updates still require their normal restart.

releases.title: Save changed conversation records and reuse unaffected client views
changes: Persist admitted runtime-progress and inactive-payload changes as scoped records instead of serializing the whole app state. Keep complete checkpoints for unknown, global and topology changes.

Reuse unaffected browser snapshots during scoped streaming updates while preserving private drafts, current revisions and previously delivered frames. Shared summary and navigation changes continue to invalidate conservatively.
Keep an exact immutable payload reference for each committed conversation view. Restart reads the last committed payload rather than a newer presentation file left by a failed save.

Preserve pending writer scopes and private client changes through SQL failures, failed presentation rollback and retries. Resource cleanup and reviewed deletion follow committed ownership without changing canonical transcripts or event logs.

Verify the scoped streaming path at a 24,000-session library scale with two independent clients. Controlled callback CPU fell by 63–69%; peak process memory was essentially unchanged. Total live-app CPU, broader global writers and full recovery cost remain separate follow-up work.

releases.title: Explain update progress and retire inactive display payloads
changes: Show the current update batch, its component names, successful configuration checks out of the admitted total, and recently installed batches. New component changes detected between batches no longer look like the same stalled preparation.

Keep earlier failed attempts distinct from current progress and preserve the original failure when cleanup cancels sibling checks. Validation, waiting for idle, and successful activation remain separate.
Bound the retained event-index working set by count and measured payload bytes. Reuse unchanged indexes without changing event parsing, execution reconstruction or canonical history.

Move eligible inactive conversation display payloads and inspection catalogs into verified app-owned resources after durable persistence. Keep connected and active work, drafts, approvals, provider configuration and receipts available; reload exact payloads on demand.

Preserve inactive payload ownership through restart, resource cleanup and reviewed deletion. Retain borrowed mutable objects conservatively and refuse missing or altered resources rather than presenting empty history.
Retain provider request-capture warnings in bounded browser details and align runtime test fixtures with the current admission and one-time environment preparation contracts.

releases.title: Resume compaction and speed up component updates
changes: Resume completed text-summary work after an interruption instead of repeating paid summaries. Save progress between completed parts, prevent hidden summary continuations, and check whether the complete history fits before making a native compaction request.

Let healthy provider calls continue without an implicit elapsed-time deadline. Preserve explicit limits and cancellations, and retain accurate output-limit, usage and request evidence across the updated Microsoft providers.
Run automatic naming periodically and quietly during ongoing work. Regenerate a chat name alongside active work while protecting later manual edits.

Add an optional Advanced diagnostics setting to record future provider requests, with credential redaction and capture limits. Existing calls cannot gain request data that was never recorded; some SDKs expose only a request summary.

Offer explicit ChatGPT Codex and Plan connections with Codex as the default. Preserve configured identities, clean up abandoned sign-in candidates safely, and explain when Plan cannot support a bounded test message.
Clear reviewed chat and workspace error markers while preserving history, current failures, pending approvals, required questions and other active obligations.

Reduce repeated update checks, source copies and module installations. Reuse exact downloaded Git revisions while retaining local edits, rollback receipts and fresh dependency resolution for each new preparation attempt.
Group equivalent update sources into one row, disclose their cache and package roles, and sort source lists alphabetically. Distinct branches, revisions, update tiers and status remain separate.

Keep Unified bundle registrations and downloaded remote caches independent of the CLI, while continuing to share configured settings, keys, native chat history and explicitly selected local resources.

Show source storage information in update details and retire only proven, unreferenced app-owned component generations after successful activation. Keep active, previous, pending, modified and uncertain generations for recovery.

notices.title: Apply compaction recovery and provider improvements
notices.detail: This release includes app, provider and context-management repairs. Existing conversation workers retain the component code they already loaded. Request recording is optional and off by default.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker for existing chats. Saved history remains available and work is not automatically replayed.

releases.title: Compact native conversation history in one request
changes: Send the complete eligible conversation window in one native compaction request, preserving the selected model, current instructions and tool definitions. Native compaction never uses text-summary fragments.

For providers that require text summaries, measure the complete summary request first and use a single summary when it fits. Split only when the provider budget, explicit source limit or unavailable measurement requires it.

Keep native checkpoints, retained reminders and original saved history intact. Record why native compaction was selected or why the text-summary path was needed; healthy calls remain free of elapsed-time deadlines.

notices.title: Compact native history in one request
notices.detail: This repair includes an updated context-management component. Existing conversation workers retain their loaded component code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker. Your saved chats remain available.

releases.title: Bound history recovery and update only affected clients
changes: Reconcile missed native-history changes in bounded background slices instead of repeated whole-library scans. Keep hot session changes responsive during recovery, retain removed history without resurrecting stale records, and update catalog totals incrementally.

Persist and publish affected session records and client details without rebuilding unrelated conversation bodies on each streamed reply. Preserve independent drafts, approvals, durable receipts and restored client selections.

Keep history discovery alive after storage failures, retry transient catalog faults even while the watcher is quiet, and coordinate shutdown with active scans. Disposable caches never replace canonical transcript or resume authority.
These changes target history, recovery and projection overhead. Isolated architecture checks and CPU measurements do not establish a causal reduction in total live-host CPU usage.

releases.title: Process changed history without copying the whole library
changes: Keep a persistent, rebuildable native-history metadata catalog and reconcile changed projects and sessions without copying every saved conversation on each refresh. Canonical transcripts and context-intelligence events.jsonl remain authoritative.

Persist changed history records and update affected indexes while preserving local drafts, approvals, receipts and pending runtime progress. Corrupt or outdated catalog data falls back to canonical discovery, and resume admission still rereads native metadata.

Reduce history-refresh CPU in a matched 24,000-session test by approximately 82%. This is a first performance increment, not a claim about total live CPU: recorded live-host idle windows did not establish an improvement. Budgeted recovery sweeps and fully selective client delivery remain follow-up work.

Add optional, bounded host profiling for debugging. Capture remains disabled by default, requires an explicit boolean debug.profiling setting and the separately installed profiling library, and preserves opaque configuration extensions.

releases.title: Let long conversations finish compaction
changes: Allow healthy conversation summaries and native compaction calls to finish without a two-minute or whole-pass deadline. Older inherited deadline settings are ignored so they cannot restart the same summary repeatedly.
Remove the Work bundle's inherited compaction timer and document why elapsed time must not cancel healthy model work. Real provider errors and user cancellation still end a call.
Require an OpenAI SDK with native Responses compaction support when updating the OpenAI provider. Older retained SDKs no longer silently disable that route.
Preserve original conversation history, completed summary fragments and pending work during compaction and recovery. No work is automatically replayed.

notices.title: Let compaction finish without repeated cancellation
notices.detail: These repairs include updated context-management, Work and OpenAI provider components. An app-only update does not replace code already loaded by a conversation worker.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker. Your saved chats remain available.

releases.title: Recover updates after a newer release is installed
changes: Verify a newer published installation when an older update is still waiting for its restart, retire the obsolete pending check and continue included component updates.

Retain the original restart failure in update history while verifying the serving release, installed dependencies and actual listener before reopening work. Unverifiable installations keep their existing safeguards.
Restore descriptive high-impact headings throughout release history while preserving reviewed notices and their existing update instructions.

releases.title: Start successfully with additional server settings
changes: Keep startup working when the private server configuration includes additional top-level settings from local tooling or other versions.
Preserve those settings during ordinary configuration saves while continuing to validate supported server settings.

releases.title: More reliable summaries in long conversations
changes: Complete conversation summaries across several parts without restarting completed summary work after a retryable timeout.
Avoid repeated summary attempts when background results arrive for unchanged conversation history.
Use the complete model request to decide when summarization is needed, avoiding inflated counts from private or duplicate transcript fields.
Keep original history and pending work intact while summaries are prepared or interrupted.

notices.title: More reliable summaries in long conversations
notices.detail: These improvements include an updated context-management component. Existing workers retain their loaded code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker. Your saved chats remain available.
previousTitles: Finish component updates

releases.title: Clear provider choices and recovery after connection changes
changes: Show the provider type and connection ID when multiple connections use the same provider, such as Anthropic (opus) and Anthropic (fable). A single connection keeps its simple provider name.
Use the exact selected connection for each model choice. Changing models never silently switches to another connection of the same provider.
Let chats saved with a removed or renamed connection show the available replacements and accept an explicit selection, even when their conversation worker cannot start.
Keep saved messages, conversation history and uncertain delivery intact during connection repair. Selecting a replacement does not resend work.

releases.title: More reliable conversation startup and recovery
changes: Keep ordinary chat available when the configured remote computer reports no active display. Computer access remains unavailable until that target is ready; no other computer is selected.
Prevent startup conflicts when bundled context managers use identical installed and cached copies of the same context module. Custom or differing sources retain their normal validation.

Keep messages saved and clearly mark them as not sent when a worker reload fails before accepting them, including when the rejection arrives after a timeout. Earlier uncertain delivery remains uncertain, and no work is replayed automatically.
Show the current startup failure and its private diagnostic reference instead of reusing an older manager error or unrelated provider timeout.

notices.title: Chat startup when a remote display is unavailable
notices.detail: The remote-display repair includes an updated computer-use component. Existing workers retain their loaded code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker. Your saved chats remain available.
previousTitles: Finish component updates

releases.title: Quieter recovery and clearer conversation failures
changes: Keep the chosen model visible through chat startup, failed startup, and reload. Preserve existing ChatGPT sign-in paths when editing a connection.
Collapse temporary canvas controls on page reload while retaining pinned controls and saved content.
Reconcile completed background work silently when its saved result is already in the conversation. Restore missing evidence without replaying the work, and report uncertain outcomes clearly.
Show readable saved-work notices with recorded status, available result and worker links, and optional technical details.
Identify when a conversation turn failed and link to its recorded details. Preserve a failed manager outcome even when its final model call succeeded.
Handle goals created or revised during an active turn in both Work and Anchors conversations.
Keep private startup diagnostic receipts and allow conversations to start when an operational computer-backend readiness failure leaves that tool unavailable.

notices.title: Saved-work recovery and goal handling
notices.detail: The recovery, goal lifecycle and computer startup fixes include updated runtime components. Existing workers retain their loaded code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing included components, then use a fresh worker.
previousTitles: Finish component updates

releases.title: Faster settings saves and shared image tools
changes: Save provider, model and bundle settings without waiting for each idle conversation to refresh. Active work keeps its loaded configuration until a safe refresh.
Reuse model lists and provider metadata across settings and conversation controls when their configuration matches. Refresh after relevant changes, on request, or after 24 hours.
Batch catalog updates and combine waiting editor changes, while keeping saves ordered and allowing them to finish during slow model-list lookups.
Make shared image generation and editing available through the public imagegen bundle, with the same input and output permissions for main agents and delegated work.
Remove the one-time reset guide for older hackathon installations from the repository.

notices.title: Shared image generation and editing
notices.detail: Shared image generation and editing also require the updated Work bundle and the imagegen component. Existing workers retain their loaded code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing components, then use a fresh worker.
previousTitles: Finish component updates

releases.title: More reliable setup, instructions, images and conversation controls
changes: Load global and project instructions reliably, resolve nested references relative to their containing instruction file, and refresh stale draft provider/model defaults.
Accept conversation attachments up to 32 MiB and adopt context repairs that avoid treating encoded image bytes as ordinary text tokens. Provider limits still apply.
Keep safe failure details and actionable app-control recovery guidance, and forward native provider timeouts correctly.
Keep Stop work available during voice calls and clear stale computer readiness when screen sharing changes.
Protect unsaved connection settings, expose Add/manage connections in the picker, and show delegation routing plus observed child provider/model and usage.
Make repeated service installation recoverable, preserve packaged login-page integrity, and document a Unified-only reset for older hackathon installs.

notices.title: Instruction, image-context and provider repairs
notices.detail: Instruction, image-context and native-provider fixes span the application and its Foundation, loop, context and OpenAI provider components. Existing workers retain their loaded code.
notices.action: Let Settings → Updates finish installing components, then use a fresh worker. Explicit source pins and custom forks remain unchanged.
previousTitles: Finish component updates

notices.title: Delegation routing and remaining compatibility limits
notices.detail: Delegation routing visibility does not enforce cross-provider consent. Ordinary tool-read recursive references, provider-aware image preparation, and physical device or Windows/WSL acceptance remain separate work.
notices.action: Review connection and routing choices before delegated work. Verify your device and provider with the intended workflow.
previousTitles: Some follow-ups remain open

releases.title: Better provider checks, complete managed updates and a cleaner canvas
changes: Send a small real test message from either provider settings screen to verify inference and see account or model errors without creating a chat.
Update app-managed Smart Tools alongside other components, validate their connections before switching while idle, and restore the previous version when needed.
Check independent runtime configurations in parallel after dependency preparation, while retaining isolated validation and dependency consistency checks.
Scroll long Chat overviews inside the canvas, keep secondary controls behind Canvas options, and use the version shortcut to reach saved revisions. Settings counters keep their compact shape.

Use supported browser call-audio mode and system mute/hang-up controls, preserve mute during interruptions, and resume existing speaker playback without creating another call. Keep the screen awake optionally during calls.
Prefer explicit Compatible API connection keys over environment defaults, consistently with other keyed providers.

notices.title: Compatible API credential refresh
notices.detail: The Compatible API credential repair is delivered in the provider component. Existing workers keep the credentials and code they already loaded.
notices.action: Let Updates finish checking and installing components, then start a fresh conversation worker to use the updated provider.
previousTitles: Finish the component update

notices.title: Mobile background calls still need device testing
notices.detail: Browser audio integration and interruption recovery are included. Uninterrupted screen-lock and car Bluetooth operation have not been verified on physical iPhone or Android devices.
notices.action: Keep the screen-awake fallback enabled when reliability is needed; test your device before relying on a locked-screen call.

releases.title: Identify the API key used by your service
changes: See a masked beginning and end of the API key for each configured connection in AI connections and advanced provider settings.
Identify whether a key comes from the service environment, private keys.env file or provider configuration, and refresh the preview after changing credentials.
Keep full keys and account sign-in tokens private, with clear guidance that existing chats may retain an earlier key.

releases.title: Restored voice behavior, quoted replies and reliable chat naming
changes: Restore the earlier voice progress behavior after a reported regression; the newer pacing behavior has been removed.
Reply to an earlier chat message with a saved quote, return to its source, and add or remove emoji reactions. Drafts and reactions survive reloads.
Generate chat names independently of the selected bundle, including older saved chats, and use Auto name now from the sidebar Rename panel. Manual names and newer edits take precedence.

notices.title: Automatic naming independent of the chat bundle
notices.detail: Automatic naming now includes the shared naming component. Existing conversation workers keep the code they already loaded.
notices.action: Let Updates finish the included-components stage. The naming repair takes effect when a fresh conversation worker starts.
previousTitles: Complete the included-components update

releases.title: Reliable workspace switching and simpler update schedules
changes: Keep the workspace heading, sidebar selection, chat list and file browser in sync when switching workspaces, including rapid switches while another chat is working.
Preserve unsent messages and attachments while browsing workspaces, and create new chats in the workspace currently being viewed.
Check for updates every four hours by default, with one-hour, four-hour, eight-hour and daily options. Existing saved schedules remain unchanged until you choose a new interval.

releases.title: Preserve saved history when a worker cannot resume
changes: Keep saved worker messages and chat details intact if restoring a provider, loading history or preparing the worker fails.
Report failed or cancelled startup attempts without replacing saved history; continue saving new work after a successful start.
Recover pending worker activity as interrupted evidence without repeating earlier tool calls.

releases.title: Reviewed conversation excerpts for actionable feedback
changes: Attach a short, explicitly selected conversation excerpt to feedback, starting with one visible message and keeping hidden instructions, tool payloads and file contents out.
Preview and edit the exact excerpt, review automatic redactions and the verified GitHub destination, then approve the specific files before sending. A changed excerpt requires fresh approval.
Preserve newer feedback edits while preparing attachments, reject stale requests after switching chats, and keep exact retries from posting the same feedback twice.

notices.title: Feedback excerpts and privacy
notices.detail: Automatic redaction can miss sensitive information. Submitted excerpts may remain in GitHub history; structured tool logs are not included.
notices.action: Review every line and the destination visibility before approving and sending.
previousTitles: Review before sharing

releases.title: Reliable tool views, precise exports and quieter voice progress
changes: Refresh saved Smart Tool connection status across open browsers and when returning to the app, preserving unfinished input and avoiding repeated tool calls.
Reuse one Canvas document when a tool identifies the same dashboard across compatible actions, while keeping independent work and exact saved-version links intact.
Preview a selected conversation range or everything from a chosen message onward, then copy or download the exact reviewed Markdown with recorded voice and artifact references.
Pace voice progress notices using current task status, wait during speech and active responses, and suppress repeated notices when nothing has changed.

releases.title: Clearer workspaces, Canvas quotes and feedback follow-ups
changes: Navigate Home, Recent chats and workspace pages, with a workspace-aware composer and clearer chat activity.
Select Markdown or plain text in Canvas and add an exact saved-version quote to the current draft. Passive selection stays private and nothing is sent automatically.
Open Chat details for cumulative recorded tokens, costs and provider/model breakdowns; copy the aggregate usage snapshot with missing or estimated values labeled.
Check unconfirmed feedback delivery without resending it, save correction drafts, publish correction comments, and close or reopen your own reports through shared user and agent actions.
Keep original feedback and maintainer edits intact, retain durable change receipts and deduplicate repeated requests.

releases.title: Durable Canvas documents and saved versions
changes: Keep repeated opens of the same file in one Canvas tab, with a saved version whenever its contents change.
Choose Latest or an earlier version, open the exact version shared in chat, and restore an older document as a new version without changing history.
Let agents inspect and revise a saved document by its identity, with protection against stale edits and unsaved viewer input.
Retain Smart Tool presentation snapshots across refreshes and reconnects; reopening the same completed operation reuses its tab. Tools can identify related presentations across separate calls.

Update the OpenAI provider component for multi-image attachment compatibility with completed computer-tool history. The provider fix preserves images and recorded actions without executing them again.

notices.title: OpenAI image attachment repair
notices.detail: The OpenAI image-attachment fix is delivered by the provider component. Updating only the application does not update every conversation worker. Some older compacted computer-use histories still need separate recovery.
notices.action: Let Updates finish the included-components stage before trying attachments again.
previousTitles: Image fix requires the provider update

releases.title: Simpler Canvas and clearer provider checks
changes: Use one Canvas viewer per browser, removing the split-view controls while keeping saved artifacts and tabs.
Copy an opened file’s absolute path or its path relative to the original workspace, clearly labeled as a path on the app server.
Explain common provider-check runtime failures, including dependency builds, imports, network trust, DNS, permissions and disk space, without exposing private subprocess logs.

releases.title: Quiet checks for recorded results
changes: Check explicitly requested results through approved, already connected read-only tools without waking a model while waiting.
Deliver a single saved background explanation when a result is ready, a check fails or the watch expires, without replaying uncertain work.
Optionally open an authorized browser result in the original Canvas after rechecking the result, connection and current selection.
Observation sources require operator approval. This release provides the host capability; individual integrations are enabled separately.

releases.title: Working voice previews and clearer Smart Tool setup
changes: Play voice samples within the browser media policy, trim startup silence and reuse recent samples for faster repeat previews.
Use detected host credentials by default when adding AI connections, with a separate private key still available.
Keep Smart Tool setup instructions with the selected installation and give advanced setup a full-width view.

releases.title: Open files from chat and preserve Canvas filenames
changes: Open local file links and path mentions in assistant replies directly in Canvas, keeping the original chat, workspace and unsent draft.
Keep the original source filename when downloading saved Canvas documents.

Preserve explicitly configured provider endpoints during setup and report provider preparation failures without exposing private configuration. Failed preparation leaves the original provider choices unchanged.

releases.title: Clearer setup, voice samples and update progress
changes: Guide Smart Tools from selection through review and installation, put installed tools first, and support adding a GitHub URL directly.
Preview speaking voices with short isolated audio samples and choose an existing environment key or a separate private key for voice.
Save built-in appearances immediately and mark notices read only when they are visible.
Show update progress, errors and disabled-action reasons above the details. Enable automatic updates when preferences are unset while preserving existing opt-outs.
Keep development previews owner-managed and preserve compatibility with older app metadata during managed upgrades.

releases.title: Clearer connections and private memory jobs
changes: Improve saved connection status and removal, offer explicit reuse of host credentials, and return Settings categories to their starting view.
Choose a speaking voice and activity detail level, set up phone notifications more clearly, and trace update badges to the items that need review.
Prompt to reload when the installed app changes, saving unsent chat drafts first and keeping them when saving fails.

Update the memory component to run suggestions through Amplifier Core sessions in its own private runtime home without requiring the Amplifier CLI. Shared provider settings remain available without writing job history into user chats.

releases.title: Simpler Settings and faster installations
changes: Open Settings around everyday tasks, with guided AI connections and all advanced controls still available.
Simplify ChatGPT device sign-in, model selection, Smart Tools batch installation, appearance, and mobile navigation while preserving saved connections and custom model rules.
Show one overall update status and keep app, included-component, and other-component updates in order.

Use published Amplifier Core native binaries for the app and conversation workers instead of compiling Core during installation. Migrate the previous app-owned Git default while preserving explicit source overrides and rollback receipts.

releases.title: Recover saved views and fork conversations reliably
changes: Reopen the original saved MCP canvas document after a restart and reconnect compatible tools without replaying calls or replacing the artifact. Show clear reasons when the source, connection or tool contract is unavailable.
Fork at verified saved message boundaries even when a later submission failed or was not confirmed. Preserve attachment identities and original history without replaying work.
Keep explicitly internal jobs and child sessions out of ordinary chat lists, counts and default searches while retaining their diagnostic histories and independent user forks.

Preview useful feedback diagnostics on demand, including delivery and failure context and the actual browser event-stream state. Preserve the accepted diagnostic snapshot and keep private text, paths and credentials out.
Shorten automatic release checks by running the full Python suite locally or on demand while retaining package, frontend and worker-runtime qualification.

notices.title: Unmarked older jobs remain visible
notices.detail: Internal jobs are hidden only when saved metadata identifies them reliably. Existing unmarked sessions are preserved and are not reclassified from their titles or prompts.
notices.action: Use the usual chat list for ordinary conversations; internal history remains available for diagnostics.

releases.title: Ordered updates and clearer conversation recovery
changes: Check and install the app first, then included components, then other sources. Continue an installation after a verified restart and show component summaries alongside the app version.
Install missing included components and preserve active work, explicit source choices, and rollback history while moving through update stages.
Resolve file mentions and composed bundle namespaces in conversation, child, and scheduled inputs using the same Foundation mechanism as the CLI.
Preserve the original attachment message during history refresh instead of displaying its expanded runtime copy as another user message.
Keep failed-turn details through passive preparation and copy fresh diagnostics when inspecting a conversation.
Simplify onboarding and document the per-user macOS service.
Keep browser validation available on demand while shortening automatic PR and release checks.

releases.title: Screen sharing that follows the conversation
changes: Share a browser tab, window or screen in text and voice, using the same explicitly granted source throughout the conversation.
Keep a visible sharing indicator and Stop control outside Chat controls, including when a voice call starts or ends.
Use the browser that sent the current message for shared-screen availability and capture, keeping other connected browsers separate.

releases.title: A consistent sidebar and easier computer controls
changes: Organize the sidebar into independently collapsible Pinned, Workspaces and Recent sections, with shared navigation and separate saved filters.
Reorder pinned chats and Settings lists with the same full-row drag preview, keyboard controls, cancellation and failed-save recovery.
Keep newly created empty workspaces visible, preserve native CLI and terminal chat discovery, and page larger chat lists.
Open scoped computer-use controls from Chat controls in text and voice, keeping source selection and capture permission explicit.

releases.title: Reliable voice snapshots, clearer startup failures and lighter background work
changes: Reduce repeated work when reading workspace preferences, indexing unchanged capture metadata and checking native conversation history.
Preserve safe worker-startup failure details through message admission so a failed message has a useful diagnosis without exposing private worker output or repeating work.
Forward optional startup resume requests to the terminal client, including the workspace-scoped picker and explicit session identifiers.
Capture fresh screenshots from stationary shared browser tabs, windows and screens during voice calls while respecting the current sharing grant and call.
Make delegated voice capabilities and available shared sources explicit so voice can use the tools supplied by the host.
Document verified Mac-to-Spark task transfer while preserving saved history and execution ownership.

notices.title: Resuming chats from the terminal
notices.detail: The Unified launcher and terminal client are separate components. Startup resume behavior requires the corresponding client update as well as this app release.
notices.action: Use a current qualified terminal client and check available component updates after updating the app.
previousTitles: Terminal resume also needs a current client

releases.title: Quieter background work and reliable conversation recovery
changes: Reduce repeated background work and disk writes by reusing unchanged history, navigation and accounting projections, avoiding redundant capture writes, and making diagnostics retention cheaper.
Match resumed model observations to their original calls, avoiding duplicate call rows and usage totals while preserving recorded child-session turn assignments.
Keep context-limit failures visibly failed with recovery details instead of reporting successful completion. Saved work is not automatically replayed.
Create named workspaces, discover shared native conversations, page workspace folders, and retain direct ordering of pinned chats.
Load bundle includes correctly when their source is a local bundle file, and inventory installed Git components as well as cached bundles when checking updates.
Remove the default deadline from provider readiness checks used when moving tasks between hosts, while retaining explicit configured limits and cancellation.
Preserve artifact-probe process ownership during cleanup and keep saved image pairs together for visual comparison.
Run independent release checks in parallel and reuse exactly matched runtime builds, shortening qualification without removing validation coverage.

notices.title: Compaction checkpoints and summary recovery
notices.detail: Provider and context-manager fixes are separate from the app package. Updated components remove default provider response deadlines, try text-summary recovery before last-resort trimming, and preserve valid compaction checkpoints when later background results arrive.
notices.action: After updating the app, check and install available component updates, then verify the versions loaded by a fresh conversation worker. Updating the app alone does not replace every companion component.
previousTitles: Update companion components for compaction improvements

releases.title: Faster controls and quieter idle work
changes: Keep browser action responses small and stream only changed state after the initial snapshot. Reconnecting restores a complete snapshot automatically.
Preview appearance changes immediately, preserving saved settings if a change fails.
Skip unchanged native history and activity scans, react to file changes, and retain periodic reconciliation and explicit refresh.
Avoid redundant saves for unchanged layout, Canvas visibility and renderer status. Keep historical usage evidence in durable storage while sending only its totals to the browser.
Keep tool and worker progress updates batched, and avoid background publications for diagnostic timestamps while Diagnostics is closed.

Keep conversations compatible with older locked Foundation workers. Report a worker startup failure as not sent when no attempt could have received the message, preserving the saved message and safe retry identity.

releases.title: Work artifacts, memory, publishing and task transfer
changes: Inspect generated image outputs through the provider's visual input path and check artifact dependencies in the worker that will create the deliverable.
Opt in separately to memory contribution and relevant-context retrieval, with source exclusions, correction handling and controls shared by the interface and agents.
Preview immutable publishing releases, record review, deploy or roll back to an inspected target, and reconcile uncertain results without automatically repeating an external action.
Export and import signed task transfers with preserved history and output evidence. Execution ownership remains fenced until the transfer is reconciled.

Inspect desktop and browser readiness, explicitly install optional native screen observation, and keep work paused when application replacement has an uncertain outcome until the serving installation is verified.
Configure optional native Microsoft 365 document tools and live Excel support through the published companion components and account setup guidance.
Keep late worker progress attached to its original run without reopening completed work or adopting a newer run's identity.
Use one composer button for voice, send and cancel. Keep chat ordering stable during background activity while reducing browser request traffic.
Context compaction calls are identified separately from ordinary replies, retain usage and safe failure details, and keep internal summary text out of the conversation.
Compaction summaries retain their requested reasoning effort when the conversation has a higher effort selected. Budget checks and model dispatch use the same setting.
Malformed app_control requests receive a clear corrective request shape before any action executes, while valid action receipts remain unchanged.

notices.title: Work skills and optional capability setup
notices.detail: Work skill and runtime improvements include separately published bundle and module changes. Memory remains opt-in. Microsoft 365, live Excel, image generation and native desktop features require their own configured services, dependencies or permissions; selecting Work does not connect accounts or grant access.
notices.action: After updating the app, check available component updates and review the setup guidance for the optional capabilities you want to use. Deliberate source pins remain in effect.
previousTitles: Update Work components and review optional setup

notices.title: Publishing access and task-transfer ownership
notices.detail: Publishing requires a configured target and an explicit access policy. Tasks retaining managed publishing state, including stopped sites or receipts, cannot transfer. Transfer requires compatible writers on both hosts and does not migrate credentials or install the destination runtime. Older session writers do not respect its ownership fence.
notices.action: Before transferring, update both hosts and upgrade or disable every CLI, TUI and runtime that can write the session, then pair the hosts and verify destination setup. Keep the source available until handoff is confirmed. Inspect saved operation state before retrying an uncertain action.
previousTitles: Choose publishing and transfer targets deliberately

notices.title: Recovery from oversized or interrupted summaries
notices.detail: The context manager and OpenAI provider repairs are separate component updates. They bound oversized summaries, retain native compaction state, and limit repeated attempts after failures.
notices.action: After the app restarts, open Settings → Updates, choose Check now, and install available component updates. Existing source pins remain in effect.
previousTitles: Update companion components for compaction recovery

releases.title: Simpler chats, stable Canvas controls and faster setup
changes: Preview Aurora, Atelier and Graphite appearances in a redesigned gallery, with light/dark modes, optional backgrounds and a persistent shared CSS appearance library.
Connected Terminal Resume and latest-session listings default to the directory where amplifier-unified tui is launched. An explicit --workspace still selects a server-side directory.
Unexpected worker startup exits retain a private local diagnostic log instead of discarding the underlying setup error.
Start chats without choosing a workspace. Each uses a private managed folder; the chat is created only when its first message is sent.
Delete managed chats through an explicit confirmation that previews the affected saved data. Workspace chats keep Archive and Restore; the ambiguous Remove action is gone.
Choose provider, model, reasoning effort and bundle directly in the composer. Compact selectors show the actual selection, group duplicate provider labels, and retain bundle descriptions.
Create folders directly in the workspace chooser. The separate New workspace entry and chat Collections feature have been removed while saved history is retained.
Canvas controls float over previews until pinned, preserving live frames and unsaved edits. Canvas opens only after a chat exists, and empty canvases offer clear file and website actions.
Embedded HTML Canvas previews can play self-contained video and audio, with play, pause, seeking and reopening verified. Remote media remains outside this preview sandbox.
The header exposes Feedback directly, keeps Settings beside More and Canvas at the right edge, and removes Activity. Agent computation and operations controls no longer occupy the chat panel.
Provider catalogs publish fewer full-state updates and reuse fresh cached models, reducing setup delays and keeping other requests more responsive.
Sidebar and Canvas layout controls save their own client view without rewriting the conversation catalog, keeping large libraries responsive during active work.
Model-call rows retain distinct request identities and independent expansion. Continued work updates its own turn summary without reopening completed history.
Selected-model request budgeting preserves Anthropic request options, and provider tool-configuration failures retain actionable diagnostics.

notices.title: Anthropic computer-tool routing
notices.detail: The matching computer-use and loop-streaming fixes are merged in their Microsoft repositories. Existing cached or pinned components are not replaced by the app package alone.
notices.action: After installing this app update, open Settings → Updates, choose Check now, and install the available component updates. Deliberate source pins remain in effect.
previousTitles: Update companion modules for Anthropic computer tools

releases.title: Reliable new chats and clear submission recovery
changes: An ordinary folder named work no longer hides the installed Work bundle when starting a conversation.
Starting a chat creates an explicitly entered workspace folder when needed and reports path errors without losing the draft.
New chat shows the correct heading and useful submission errors. Confirmed unsent local messages can be discarded, while uncertain deliveries remain available for checking.
Successful forms clear their submitted drafts while preserving newer typing, failed submissions, and feedback receipts.
Native model and tool activity stays grouped with the user turn that started it instead of creating duplicate Working groups.

releases.title: Keep the app responsive while preparing conversations
changes: Preparation updates are grouped so loading a conversation does not hold up controls or worker replies. Delivery, approvals, usage and failures remain durably recorded.
Schedule displays use one shared database read instead of a separate query for every saved conversation.
Connected browsers reuse folder and navigation calculations while keeping their own selections, filters and drafts, reducing delays in large conversation libraries.
Embedded tool views wait for visibility acknowledgement before resuming reads, preventing a false error when reopening a hidden panel.

releases.title: Responsive conversations with multiple connected clients
changes: Browser observations avoid full-library saves, and connected views share bounded presentation work while keeping separate selections and drafts.
Canvas tool reads are bounded and visibility-aware, preventing automatic refreshes from accumulating behind slow requests.
Pinned model choices reuse prepared app context between request budgeting and dispatch.

releases.title: Refresh history only for connected views
changes: Closed browser tabs and finished terminal or API clients no longer keep old conversation logs refreshing in the background.
Browser and terminal history follow their live subscriptions, while saved drafts and reconnect state remain intact. Active work continues to be observed after clients disconnect.

releases.title: Reliable component updates and shared module loading
changes: Older installations can update components whose only local changes are generated cache files, while preserving source edits, staged changes and pinned versions.
Component preparation respects platform-specific dependencies, avoiding Windows-only installs on Mac and Linux.
App-selected modules use a consistent source when bundles or child agents include them again, while retaining their settings and separate configured instances.
Failed updates identify the preparation stage and provide recovery guidance. Current components and saved conversations remain available; conversation work is not replayed.

notices.title: Recovery from failed component updates
notices.detail: Install this application update before retrying a component update that failed during preparation.
notices.action: After the app restarts, open Settings → Updates, choose Check now, then Install available.
previousTitles: Retry a previously failed component update

releases.title: Persistent work, shared controls and reusable outputs
changes: Start managed commands, follow their output, answer pending questions and coordinate workers while keeping conversation drafts and saved history intact.
Save task objectives and corrections across compaction and restart, schedule later continuation, and move execution into an isolated Git worktree with a recorded handoff.
Search saved work, manage scoped memory, organize and archive conversations, and deliberately publish fixed conversation snapshots.
Keep Python or Node variables across computation cells, attach and review saved outputs, and discover installed artifact runtimes.
Use approved tools from bounded programs, connect supported MCP services, fetch attributable web sources, and explicitly share browser-selected visual context during voice.
Inspect attributed usage and enforce supported model-call budgets, with optional native provider direction and compaction where available.

notices.title: Work capabilities and trusted execution
notices.detail: Work features require their corresponding updated modules. Persistent computation requires a trusted execution configuration; creating a runtime does not relax tool permissions.
notices.action: Update the corresponding Work modules and review trusted execution settings before using these features.
previousTitles: Review Work modules and execution settings

notices.title: Scheduling availability and budget coverage
notices.detail: Schedules require an available capable host. Budgets cover recorded supported model-call boundaries, not all account spending or already-started work.
notices.action: Keep the host available for scheduled work and inspect recorded usage alongside account usage.
previousTitles: Keep scheduling and budget limits in view

notices.title: Provider features and visual-context permissions
notices.detail: Native provider features depend on model and account support. Foreground desktop capture requires the optional native desktop component and an explicit active voice grant for that host.
notices.action: Check model support and choose the intended browser screen or desktop host before granting visual access.
previousTitles: Check provider and visual-context support

notices.title: Interrupted work and uncertain results
notices.detail: Interrupted work with an unknown result is retained for inspection. Restart does not automatically rerun commands or computation cells.
notices.action: Inspect the saved operation state and any external effects before deciding whether to retry.
previousTitles: Inspect interrupted work before retrying

releases.title: Reliable conversation recovery, runtime updates, and Settings navigation
changes: Conversations use the same module cache validated by the ecosystem updater, including reopened conversations.
Chat details shows actionable module loading failures and clears older failure reports after a successful preparation.

Check delivery can reconcile saved messages after reload or from another client. Sending an uncertain message again requires an explicit confirmation and preserves its original identity and attachments.
Runtime repair, reset, and failed application replacement leave the running host able to start work. Rollback retries preserve the intended previous version.
Mobile Settings restores your list position when returning from details, including on slower devices.
Validated shell components can replace supported controls through the same user and agent actions while preserving drafts and built-in recovery.
Update controls are easier to find in Settings, with older update activity grouped for easier scanning.
Saved terminal connections open in your preferred terminal, with corrected Mac shortcuts and clearer setup feedback.

releases.title: Guided terminal setup, complete themes, and full-screen phone navigation
changes: Guided terminal setup installs the client and saves a secure connection to your Unified host. Device access can be reviewed and revoked.

Themes can provide complete light and dark palettes, backgrounds, and optional decoration. Saved appearance loads before the conversation interface, preserving restored Settings and composer controls.
Chat details groups naming and diagnostics controls, and naming changes use the shared user and agent actions.
Workspace navigation fills the screen on phones and other narrow windows, including folded-phone widths, while preserving unsent drafts.
Release packages exclude temporary build dependencies and are checked for accidental inclusion before publication.

releases.title: Mobile navigation, retained Canvas, and project access
changes: Narrow windows show full-width chat, the conversation title, and navigation and action drawers with larger touch targets.
Settings opens one section or editor at a time on narrow windows, preserving drafts and browser Back navigation. Ordering drafts refresh safely when routing choices change.
Canvas shows and hides immediately while retaining its viewers, scroll position, and unsaved edits.
Default interface text is larger. Customized or renamed skins retain their settings.
File tools retain access to the selected project when extra writable folders are configured, while preserving explicitly denied folders and narrower patch-tool restrictions.
Typed context-limit failures now show recovery guidance in conversation diagnostics.

releases.title: Restore recipe agent and report steps
changes: Ordinary recipe agent steps can run again, fixing the child-session option error that stopped validation and audit recipes before their final reports.
Recipe children retain conversation approvals, working directories, and saved history. Recipes requesting subprocess isolation receive a clear unsupported-mode error before the child starts.

releases.title: Keep local source validation results visible
changes: Validation and save confirmations now remain visible for relative paths and file URLs, while the saved source retains its resolved path.
Changing the source type hides an earlier module validation result so it cannot describe a bundle candidate.

releases.title: Validate replacement module sources before saving
changes: Module validation now checks the same effective source selected by the runtime, including scoped source overrides.
The source editor can validate a candidate without saving it, and validates module replacements before saving. Failed validation leaves the saved source unchanged.
Release publication refuses an existing version tag at a different commit, so a later fix cannot silently reuse an older release.
Delayed acknowledgements for voice requests and edited-message forks stay unconfirmed until resolved, without falsely failing the turn or replaying the request.

releases.title: Keep delayed message delivery separate from stopped work
changes: A delayed message acknowledgement no longer marks the conversation or its running work as failed. The saved message stays unconfirmed until delivery can be established.
A late acknowledgement updates the original message without resending it or restarting a finished turn. Genuine worker failures continue to report an error.

releases.title: An optional terminal client for shared conversations
changes: Install the optional terminal client and use amplifier-unified tui to join the same conversations as the web app. Each terminal keeps its own selection and draft while messages, results and pending decisions stay shared.
The terminal supports reconnecting, history browsing, rename, approvals, Stop and cooperative takeover. Closing it leaves work running on the service.
Automatic naming uses the shared session naming hook and preserves custom names, including against late generated results.
Application updates retain the optional terminal client. If the installed selection changes after validation, retrying the update validates it again without interrupting active work.
The terminal client is early access. Voice, uploads, rich canvas, full settings editing and queue/steer remain available through the web app.

releases.title: Keep reconnected chats ready to send
changes: Reconnected chats load their saved history automatically, so Send becomes available without switching away and back. Your unsent draft stays in place.
Saved history refresh follows the chats open in connected browsers. Reconnecting or reading history does not start a worker or replay previous work.

releases.title: Collapse every work section
changes: Every Worked for or Working section can be expanded and collapsed, including sections with only a few actions.
Work sections use the same saved expansion controls at every size. Collapsing a section preserves its individual action choices and keeps interim replies in place.

releases.title: Compact actions and inspectable model requests
changes: Actions start as one-line summaries inside their chronological work groups. Expand a tool to inspect its input and result; brief worker containers add no extra disclosure.
Expand a model call for timing, usage, message and tool counts, and recorded request options. Large raw requests load from the existing event log only when requested; short requests appear directly.
Full request copy, retry, source-change checks and the 15-line/full or 10-line/preview behavior are preserved. Request bodies stay out of initial browser state and saved execution views.

releases.title: Settings collections that keep the details within reach
changes: Models, bundles and Smart Tools use compact lists with focused details. The whole row responds to hover and selection, while checkboxes stay independent.

Reorder provider preferences, routing choices and bundle composition in dedicated views. Neighboring rows move as you drag, a line shows where the item will land, and Save commits the draft. Buttons and keyboard controls provide the same choices.
